verdicts.citation: SPEC.md 7.4 'Without JavaScript' (no [D] mark): 'A Playwright run with JavaScript disabled checks, for every lesson, that the text, every default figure and every table are present.' SPEC 3 M8 figure table: beat 3 'T12 on A2, node 1, relation checker', beat 4 'T12 on D4 node 1, then E6 node 1, then E7 node 7', beat 5 'T12 on A2: the move matrix beside its signed version'. SPEC 4 T12 (phase 5): 'the orbit drawn in layers with edges coloured by node; the matrices E_k, F_k, H_k shown as grids'. These passages support the finding's expected.
verdicts.evidence: Worktree detached at 006f50d (git status clean, no node_modules or dist). Nothing was run except reading. (1) nojs.spec.ts:62-151 at 006f50d: toolReport classifies a root as 'board' when any visible [data-board-group] outside details/noscript has a [data-node] beside an svg with children. figureProblems checks only kind, text alternative and node hooks. No line reads [data-out="orbit-graph"], [data-vertex], [data-edge] or MatrixView cells. The table check compares the count of <table> in the DOM with the count in the same HTML file. (2) M8.spec.ts:251-268 'M8 renders without JavaScript': per instance it checks caption, noscript, disabled controls, the orbit table's caption, the board table's count, the dimension text and matrix-e toHaveCount(1). No vertex and no cell. entriesOf (cells) is used only in the with-JS test 'every figure states its expected result' (b3, b4, b8). (3) T12.spec.ts:601-616 counts [data-vertex]=3 without JavaScript on /tools/rep/ only, which is not a lesson. For matrices it checks only data-format=grid. (4) The reproducer, read as text at worktree-agent-a67d4655cc5955fd5, asserts exactly the claim: it removes vertices, edges and [data-row][data-col] cells, then expects toolReport to reject the T12 roots. (5) Phase: 9.1 row 5 builds T12 and M8 at gate G5. gate-G5.md (report commit 28fa75a; its line names 006f50d as the gate commit) records nojs.spec.ts as passing, with no open item on this. 7.7 'Without JavaScript' is required for every merge that touches a lesson or a tool. (6) Records: DECISIONS.md 'RT-FIX-P3-test-integrity: the default figure of the run without JavaScript' and 'RT-FIX-P4-tool-t10 ... (P4-RT-06-02)' are builder records of the predicate. They have no [D], section 10 default or owner answer, they cover only boards, drawings, imgs and canvas snapshots, and they say nothing about T12. decisions/P5-A2.md and P5-A3.md record no choice to accept T12 by its string-viewer board. The P5-A3 brief's checklist expects 'M8 reads completely without JavaScript: prose, every default figure' through M8.spec.ts. Precedent: the round-p4 refute verdict on P4-RT-06-02 (the same cause for T10) was not refuted. (7) Lens file section 6 has no exclusion for this. The P5 known-and-decided list has nothing on it, and no merge-P5-redteam report exists. Partial overstatement, from the source and not run: the T12 header comment says the matrices are redrawn from the state after hydration, while the orbit 'stays the server's until the state changes'. So nojs.spec.ts's server-against-hydrated comparison of data-out text would probably catch a server-only loss of matrix cells, but not a loss of the orbit drawing. This weakens the claim's 'would pass the whole run' for the matrices only. The cause stands.
verdicts.reason: not refuted: R1 failed because no sentence permits a no-JS check that skips part of a default figure. 7.4 asks for every default figure for every lesson, and M8's figure table makes the matrices the figure of beats 3 to 5. R2 failed because the finding reads 7.4 and T12 correctly. Its only overstatement (the server-against-hydrated comparison may catch lost matrix cells) leaves the orbit-drawing gap and the predicate's blind spot in place. R3 failed because T12 and M8 are phase 5 at gate G5. R4 does not apply, since no oracle quantity is involved. R5 failed because 7.4 and T12 carry no [D], and the DECISIONS predicate entries are builder records that do not cover T12. R6 failed because there is no earlier record: P4-RT-06-02's fix and regression cover canvas snapshots only, and gate-G5.md has no open item. Minor fits the rubric ('a test that could be stronger without being wrong'), since the server markup does hold the orbit and the matrices.
